title: Client KEXINIT after the initial KEX but before authentication is not answered with KEXINIT
quote: When this message is received, a party MUST respond with its own SSH_MSG_KEXINIT message, except when the received SSH_MSG_KEXINIT already was a reply.
rationale: Pre-auth rekey: KEXINIT after NEWKEYS (with or without SERVICE_ACCEPT) answered without KEXINIT (v1 D3: OpenSSH answers UNIMPLEMENTED, deliberately). Narrower than the catalogue's REKEY-KEXINIT-REPLY, which also covers post-auth. Written by proto-sm stream A (v2) from v1 class D3 (report.md); vocabulary: teammate mapper (UNIMPLEMENTED, SERVICE_ACCEPT, CLOSED/NO_CONN, UA_PW_OK). An accepting word is a behaviour witness, not necessarily a bug.
